newsitem.title: POLAND: ANDRZEJ DOROSZ LIKELY TO HEAD BANK PEKAO SA.
newsitem.headline: ANDRZEJ DOROSZ LIKELY TO HEAD BANK PEKAO SA.

text.p: The supervisory board of state-owned Bank Pekao SA has chosen the bank's deputy president Andrzej Dorosz as the only candidate for new chief excecutive, Pekao's press officer said on Monday.
"Andrzej Dorosz is the candidate for bank president," Marek Minarczuk told Reuters.
Dorosz will be appointed president after his candidacy is cleared by the National Bank of Poland, the central bank, which is not expected to oppose Pekao's choice.
Dorosz was chosen head after the bank's previous president Marian Kanton died in a road accident two weeks ago.
